parts.text: The Doubtfire sisters are driving home with 7 kittens adopted from the local animal shelter when their mother calls to inform them that their two house cats have just had kittens.
She says that Patchy, the first cat, has had thrice the number of adopted kittens, while Trixie, the other cat, also has some.
Doubtfire family now have 40 kittens in total.
How many kittens does Trixie have?

parts.text: The Doubtfire siblings have just adopted 7 kittens from a nearby animal rescue center.
During their journey home, they receive a call from their mother who tells them that their two pet cats have also given birth to kittens.
The first cat, Patchy, has given birth to a number of kittens that is three times the number of adopted kittens.
The second cat, Trixie, has given birth to 12 kittens.
What is the total number of kittens that the Doubtfire family now owns?
